verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is payment infrastructure/APIs that enable third-party AI agents (e.g., shopping assistants) to transact on a user's behalf — it is not itself a product with a built-in AI assistant persona that a user chats with or delegates tasks to. The evidence describes enrollment, tokenization, consent/mandates, and the Trusted Agent Protocol for verifying external agents, none of which constitutes a built-in assistant inside Visa's own product.
